coverage.scope_note: Zero blanks applies only to the Cartesian product of five selected seed routes and two schema-only mock assets named in population_preimage; it is not a completeness percentage or a universal denominator.

non_claims: The mock population is intentionally incomplete and does not represent all routes, assets, curves, protocols, implementations, or adversary models.
Every cell remains unknown and unmeasured; field completeness is not scientific resolution.
No cell authorizes production-target testing or operational key recovery.
Zero blank cells in this fixture does not discharge WS5-G1 or WS5-G2.
